summary: Londonderry/Eglinton instrument landing system usable during air traffic control hours only; the online UK aeronautical publication contains erroneous information.
text:
UK AIP AIRAC 13/2026 AVAILABLE AT
HTTPS://WWW.AURORA.NATS.CO.UK/HTMLAIP/PUBLICATIONS/
2026-12-24-AIRAC/HTML/INDEX-EN-GB.HTML CONTAINS ERRONEOUS
INFORMATION.
LONDONDERRY/EGLINGTON RADIO NAVIGATION AND LANDING AIDS.
ILS/GP IEGN REMARKS TO READ:
3 DEGREES ILS REF DATUM HGT 60FT. 
GP FLAGS MAY BE EXPERIENCED WHEN 8 DEGREES RIGHT OF THE OFFSET
LOCALISER CENTRELINE AND WELL BELOW GLIDEPATH. 
ILS/GP USABLE DURING ATC HOURS ONLY.
ILS/GP IEGT REMARKS TO READ:
3 DEGREES ILS REF DATUM HGT 50FT. 
ILS/GP USABLE DURING ATC HOURS ONLY.
UK AIP EGAE AD 2.19 AND DIGITAL AIP DATASET REFERS.
